metadata.title: हेमंत सोरेन को जेल भेजने वालों से नाराज़ आदिवासी | Adivasis rally behind Hemant Soren in Jharkhand
metadata.description: "Former Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren's arrest under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act has sparked controversy. The Main Bhi Bharat team delves into the Adivasi community's perspective by visiting Soren's village. Local Adivasis assert that Soren is being unfairly targeted by the BJP. Explore the comprehensive ground report for a nuanced understanding of the situation."
